description: A former crown prince of a prosperous kingdom whose study and noble deeds led to godhood. The synopsis says he fell from the heavens and was banished to the world below, then eight hundred years after his mortal life ascended to godhood for a third time. Sent to the Mortal Realm to repay debts, he hunts violent ghosts and troublemaking spirits that prey on the living.
